FFs to become ‘honorary citizens’: BNP
2018-12-18T12:56:51+06:00 | Star Online Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/bangladesh-national-election-2018/bangladesh-freedom-fighters-become-honorary-citizens-bnp-manifesto-pledges-1675393

BNP is offering plenty of benefits to the Freedom Fighters, promising them to be upheld as ‘honorary citizens’ of the state in its manifesto.

The party, also a component of Jatiya Oikyafront, has pledged to curb all corruption within the system of Freedom Fighters’ registration.

It has also pledged to increase allowances and benefits for the families of Freedom Fighters in conjunction with the inflation of the country.

BNP has also promised to make a comprehensive list of martyrs all across the country, and also uncover all the undiscovered Freedom Fighters.
